page.overview:
Who is Dawn?

Dawn is the female playable character in Pokémon Diamond Version and Pokémon Pearl Version, their third version and their remakes. Her counterpart is Lucas.

Dawn is a short young girl with a slender build, navy blue hair, fair skin, and blue-gray eyes. She is usually seen wearing a white beanie cap with a pink Poké Ball design on it. She has a pink Pokétch on her left arm.

Dawn wears a V-neck black mini sweater dress with a very short pink skirt at the bottom, a white blouse underneath, a red scarf, gold hair clips, black knee high socks, pink boots, and a yellow bag.

Dawn wears an outfit slightly more suitable for the colder weather in Sinnoh: she wears a red overcoat with multiple pink buttons on it, a white scarf, and a white bag. She also wears white knee length socks instead of black ones, pink hair clips instead of gold ones, and lighter colored pink boots with white buttons.
